root_cause: The existing original growth source collector #175 persisted only GA4 CSV, GSC, website events, social and revenue goal. It did not persist daily source-backed DataForSEO, SEO provider keyword recency, external signal acceptance, web-page CRO funnels, blog live readback, AI-content recommendation status, or technical audit proof boundaries. Other original BRAIN/Heartbeat functions never read the daily source table at all, so a fresh source row did not imply downstream consumption.
impact: Fresh provider activity could be wrongly interpreted as current keyword opportunity data. Original GSC summary contained a stale actual provider date despite recent source registry activity. Website daily metrics and SEO intelligence did not produce BRAIN/Heartbeat consumer ACKs, leaving CRO experiment decisions untraceable.

evidence.safety_contract: Original consumer is not accepted until source SHA256 identity recheck, and no synthetic provider metric or CRO winner is claimed.

prevention: Keep original #175 as producer of 7 additional per-day source classes, with exact raw-source revision and quality status, then store SHA256 canonical tenant/day/source manifest in the ORIGINAL ONE BRAIN obligation. Existing #140 independently re-reads that source manifest and produces idempotent consumer ACK, source-bound CRO test recommendation (never an asserted actual experiment) and original Heartbeat readback. Missing provider keyword/audit data, failed reads, unverified blogs, causal effects and revenue must stay visibly pending. Retain original provider and security controls; no second scheduler.
